<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="סיון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918679_theRebbe_674" batchId="meluket-_D7_A1_D7_99_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918679_theRebbe_674__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>When Israel below issues a halachic ruling that the time for redemption has arrived, the redemption comes immediately.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this, when Israel below issue a halachic ruling according to Torah that the time of the redemption has already arrived</t>
    <t s="1">(for all the appointed times have elapsed,</t>
    <t s="2">and Israel has already done teshuvah),</t>
    <t s="3">— so it shall be fulfilled, and immediately and at once the redemption comes.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The holiday of Shavuot is connected to Moshe Rabbeinu, who received and transmitted the Torah, and to the instruction to raise many students, which includes every Jew.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And to add that the holiday of Shavuot is connected to Moshe Rabbeinu,</t>
    <t s="2">for Moshe</t>
    <t s="3">received the Torah from Sinai and transmitted it, etc., until the Men of the Great Assembly, who said, "Raise up many students,"</t>
    <t s="4">in which</t>
    <t s="5">("many students")</t>
    <t s="6">is included every single Jew,</t>
    <t s="7">men, women, and children.</t>
    <t s="8">[And it can be said that the meaning of "raise up many students" is also that each one of the students</t>
    <t s="9">(i.e., each one of Israel)</t>
    <t s="10">becomes a pillar,</t>
    <t s="11">through whom are sustained all three pillars upon which the world stands].</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Shavuot is also connected to King Dovid and the Baal Shem Tov, and its days are especially suited for learning and spreading Torah in a way of renewal that reveals the renewal of creation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the holiday of Shavuot is connected to King Dovid and the Baal Shem Tov,</t>
    <t s="1">whose yahrzeits fall on Shavuot.</t>
    <t s="2">And since the concept of the renewal of creation is the Baal Shem Tov's explanation of the verse "Forever, O L-rd, Your word stands firm in the heavens,"</t>
    <t s="3">a verse in Tehillim recited by Dovid, the sweet singer of Israel,</t>
    <t s="4">therefore,</t>
    <t s="5">the days of Shavuot are especially conducive to the study and dissemination of Torah in the manner of "raise up many students,"</t>
    <t s="6">and that the study and dissemination each day,</t>
    <t s="7">and all the more so each year,</t>
    <t s="8">should be in a manner of ascending in holiness, and even in a manner of renewal,</t>
    <t s="9">for through renewal in Torah is revealed</t>
    <t s="10">(as above)</t>
    <t s="11">the renewal of creation,</t>
    <t s="12">that all creatures are renewed from nothing to existence every moment.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
